what: a plain wooden torch: a short rough stick of pine with its top end wrapped in dark rags soaked in black pitch, burning with a smoky orange flame.
colours: Raw pale brown pine wood; near-black pitch-soaked rags; orange and yellow flame with a little grey smoke.
pose: Lying diagonally by itself, burning end at the top right, seen from a little above.
must_show: dark rags wrapped round the top

what: a small old tin lantern with a ring handle on top and windows of thin scraped cow horn, pale honey-coloured and see-through, glowing warm from the flame inside.
colours: Dull grey tin; pale honey-amber horn panes glowing warm yellow from inside.
pose: Standing upright by itself, seen from the front and a little from above.

what: a blackened iron lantern with a single round window on its front and a sliding iron shutter half closed over the window, a narrow beam of warm light coming out of the open half.
colours: Black and dark grey iron; one warm yellow beam of light.
pose: Standing upright by itself, seen from the front and a little to one side.
must_show: a sliding shutter half over the window

what: an old Roman oil lamp of pale silver-grey metal with a small handle and a long spout, a steady pure white flame standing still at the spout, the kind said to burn for centuries in sealed tombs.
colours: Pale silver-grey metal with a little tarnish; a pure white flame with a faint blue edge.
pose: Lying by itself, spout to the right, seen from the side and a little from above.
must_show: one oil lamp with a spout
a white flame at the spout

what: a hollowed-out turnip, cream-white with a purple top and a short tuft of stalks, carved with a jagged grinning face, a single glowing red-orange coal of hellfire inside lighting the face from within.
colours: Cream-white turnip skin turning purple at the top; dark green-brown stalks; red-orange glow inside the carved face.
pose: Sitting by itself, carved face toward the viewer, seen from the front.

what: a small ancient Greek oil lamp of red-brown fired clay, round with a short spout and a little ring handle, a small flame burning at the spout and one bright drop of hot oil about to fall from it.
colours: Red-brown terracotta clay with a darker blackened spout; a small yellow-orange flame; one golden drop of oil.
pose: Lying by itself, spout to the right, seen from the side and a little from above.

what: a bronze hanging lamp made to burn in a tower window, hung from a short bronze chain, its glass sides glowing with a strong warm beacon light.
colours: Warm dark bronze with green patina in the corners; strong warm gold light inside.
pose: Hanging straight down from its short chain by itself, seen from the front.
must_show: a short chain at the top

what: a tall slender torch of black wood bound with silver bands, burning with a pale silver-white flame that gives no smoke: the torch of the goddess of crossroads and the night.
colours: Black wood; bright silver bands; a pale silver-white flame with a faint cold blue edge.
pose: Lying diagonally by itself, flame at the top right, seen from a little above.
